blockingFindings.title: R1 shared guard source is not verified
blockingFindings.issue: The test hardcodes TARGET_GUARDS and compares the registry entry to that local array. An implementation could duplicate the three option strings directly in get.resolve-context instead of accepting them through the existing FLOW_TARGET_GUARD_OPTIONS, and this test would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Import or otherwise reference the production FLOW_TARGET_GUARD_OPTIONS in the test and assert the resolve-context registry options come from that shared guard option definition, not an independently hardcoded equivalent list.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 explicitly requires use of the existing FLOW_TARGET_GUARD_OPTIONS, but the current spec-local coverage only verifies equivalent option strings, leaving an acceptance requirement uncovered.
